explanation: This function is vulnerable to OS command injection (CWE-78) because user_input is concatenated directly into os.system('ls -l ' + user_input). Crafted input containing shell metacharacters could execute arbitrary OS commands. The repair uses subprocess.run(["ls", "-l", user_input], check=True) with shell=False, passing user_input as a single argument and preventing shell injection (though '--' is absent).
